exposure: Class I-II obesity in ART pregnancies
Class III obesity in ART pregnancies
cohort: The study included 48,365 pregnant patients who conceived with assisted reproductive technology (ART) from January 2012 to September 2015, categorized by non-obesity, class I-II obesity, and class III obesity.
finding: Morbidly obese pregnant patients who conceived with ART, particularly those with class III obesity, have increased risks of adverse fetal and maternal outcomes including severe maternal morbidity, hypertensive disorders, diabetes, large for gestational age neonates, and intrauterine fetal demise.
